description:
**File**: `src/quickheadlines.cr:218`

**Severity**: P4 (consistency)

```crystal
spawn do
  sleep 0.5.seconds
  Process.on_terminate do |_reason|
    initiate_shutdown("signal")
    ...
  end
end
```

This is a one-shot startup fiber, but it bypasses
`FiberTracker.tracked_spawn`. The audit notes this as a consistency
issue. Either:
1. Use `tracked_spawn` for consistency (and accept that this
   one-shot fiber counts toward `active_fibers` for ~0.5s), or
2. Add a comment explaining why this particular spawn is exempt

The fiber is short-lived so the impact on diagnostics is
negligible, but consistency is valuable.

**Related**: `quickhea-hc7` (Wire FiberTracker into the actual
spawn sites) is closed. This ticket is the only remaining
untracked spawn.

Found during code review 2026-06-18, see
`planning/code-review-2026-06-18.md` §6 positive findings note.
title: quickheadlines.cr:218 uses untracked spawn for shutdown re-trap
